derivation_data: all already-accessed exact n<=4 structures only
canonicalization: hypergraph labels must be invariant under the registered structure symmetries; equivalent relabellings canonicalize to one signature before minimality is assessed
theorem_targets: T1 local witness: every n<=4 mixed regime contains a minimal connected obstruction signature from O
T2 disjoint-union stability: if components are obstruction-free and objective coupling is absent under the frozen grammar, their disjoint union is obstruction-free
T3 gluing sufficiency: every regime-changing mixed fibre created by admissible gluing contains one of the prospectively frozen boundary obstruction signatures
T4 prediction: obstruction presence/absence defines a deterministic n=5 regime forecast without evaluating the exact n=5 referee
prospective_gate: Commit O, its canonicalization/checker, and every n=5 challenge instance/prediction before computing any n=5 exact label. A post-label edit to O is a new identity, never a repair.
